principle: Own your lane. Help every other lane. Never steal its authority.

mayAssist: source acquisition for Beta causal questions
none; deterministic and specialist paths should be exhausted first

handoffRules: Every assist request retains a root owner.
Helpers produce evidence or bounded analysis, not a replacement authoritative perspective.
Unchanged failed requests become dormant until the input signature changes.
A dependency cycle must be escalated as a deadlock, not circulated.
No assist request can modify canonical state directly.
persistenceRules: Preserve immutable evidence/history and canonical authority. Never rewrite or force-update history.
Normal one-file Contents API writes are allowed when the connector accepts them.
If a Contents API create/update write is rejected by connector safety before repository mutation, that interface failure is not itself a repository persistence blocker.

Fallback to Git Data persistence: fetch the latest main HEAD and tree; create blobs for the intended immutable files; create a tree based on that latest tree; create a commit whose parent is that exact HEAD; then move main with a non-force fast-forward update_ref.
If the non-force ref update loses a race, refetch the latest main HEAD/tree and retry the same intended blobs on top of the new HEAD. Never use force=true.
Evidence artifacts must be committed before the role-run receipt that claims them. Multiple completed evidence artifacts may share one evidence commit; the receipt must follow in a later commit.
Do not mark persistence unavailable until materially distinct lawful persistence paths have failed. Record the exact failed interface/path and preserve all gate, provenance, and authority rules.
